kind: Pluriharmonic transform and tangent critical-input review
scope: Exact published/preprint transform and compact tangent interfaces, one direct whole-fiber horizontal descent proof and a local countercheck.
mathematical_boundary: The exact interfaces have scoped statement/proof readings. No complete external secondary-tree certification, full Siu adoption, higher-bidegree classification or movable density identity.

direct_obligations.name: Fiber bundle
direct_obligations.check: Holomorphic local trivializations include the whole connected fiber; base dimension is at least one.

direct_obligations.name: Coefficient measure
direct_obligations.check: Positive (1,1)-current has order-zero coefficients with positive Hermitian trace densities.

direct_obligations.name: Vertical trace
direct_obligations.check: A strictly positive smooth base volume removes the entire vertical diagonal coefficient.

direct_obligations.name: Mixed coefficients
direct_obligations.check: Positive matrix Cauchy--Schwarz removes all mixed entries after the vertical diagonal vanishes.

direct_obligations.name: Horizontal equation
direct_obligations.check: The dz,dbarz,dwalpha,dbarwbeta coefficient of partial-barpartial S contains just the fiber Laplacian of the corresponding horizontal coefficient.

direct_obligations.name: Base tests
direct_obligations.check: Compactly supported nonnegative base tests give globally defined nonnegative scalar distributions on the entire fiber.

direct_obligations.name: Fiber charts
direct_obligations.check: Horizontal forms have no fiber differential, so each coefficient is a scalar generalized function under fiber-coordinate changes.

direct_obligations.name: Weyl regularity
direct_obligations.check: Distributional harmonicity gives a smooth nonnegative harmonic function in fiber charts.

direct_obligations.name: Whole line
direct_obligations.check: Nonnegative harmonic functions on the entire complex line are constant by harmonic Liouville.

direct_obligations.name: Compact curve
direct_obligations.check: Harmonic functions on a compact connected curve are constant by maximum principle.

direct_obligations.name: Polarization
direct_obligations.check: Quadratic coefficients for all constant complex vectors recover every Hermitian entry.

direct_obligations.name: Signed base tests
direct_obligations.check: Every real smooth compactly supported test is a difference of nonnegative tests using a fixed bump on its support.

direct_obligations.name: Product distributions
direct_obligations.check: Constant paired fiber distributions force each coefficient to be pulled back from the base.

direct_obligations.name: Base positivity
direct_obligations.check: A nonnegative compact fiber density of integral one identifies positive base coefficients.

direct_obligations.name: Pullback injection
direct_obligations.check: The same fiber-density test proves injectivity on arbitrary base distributions.

direct_obligations.name: Base ddc
direct_obligations.check: Commutation and injection make the base current ddc-closed.

direct_obligations.name: Gluing
direct_obligations.check: Two base currents pull back to the same current over an overlap and hence agree.

direct_obligations.name: Closed case
direct_obligations.check: Commutation and injection also descend exterior closedness when it holds.

direct_obligations.name: Zero case
direct_obligations.check: The zero current gives the zero base current without invoking a horizontal dimension.

direct_obligations.name: Local countercheck
direct_obligations.check: The displayed coefficient is positive harmonic on the unit disc and nonconstant; vertical trace vanishes and descent fails.

direct_obligations.name: Compact tangent scope
direct_obligations.check: B=V and Omega=X make both boundary regularity conditions vacuous in the exact Corollary1.21(7).

direct_obligations.name: Tangent decomposition
direct_obligations.check: For the corollary T+=T and T-=0 are legitimate positive pluriharmonic currents; the separate approximation theorem produces its own decomposition.

direct_obligations.name: Normal trace
direct_obligations.check: Positive measures of shrinking bounded tubes tend to divisor mass, which is zero under the declared premise.

direct_obligations.name: No high bidegree
direct_obligations.check: Only the matrix (1,1)-case is reconstructed; no higher-p current classification is inferred.

direct_obligations.name: AB compactness
direct_obligations.check: Exceptional divisors of compact modifications are compact, making their nonnegative weakly psh coefficients constant.

direct_obligations.name: Aeppli class
direct_obligations.check: Published Definition3.3 uses Aeppli classes; compact Kähler ddc lemma identifies the cohomological interface.

direct_obligations.name: Point coefficient
direct_obligations.check: Vigny Lemma2.1 and its Section5 extension give exceptional mass, with normalized divisor mass one.

direct_obligations.name: Locator precision
direct_obligations.check: Three exact-version locator mismatches are recorded without treating them as mathematical counterexamples.

direct_obligations.name: Operator convention
direct_obligations.check: Nguyen ddc is twice the book operator, preserving the vanishing condition and positivity.

direct_obligations.name: External boundary
direct_obligations.check: Indicator/regularization/support/older extension and transform kernels remain imported or pending, not newly proved.

direct_obligations.name: Movable boundary
direct_obligations.check: The unidentified To-appear cohomological density identity remains unverified and deferred.

mathematics.prototype_scope: Positive horizontal (1,1)-current descent on whole line or compact connected curve fibers, with the closed-current consequence and local-disc countercheck.

exact_secondary_interfaces.Nguyen2111.11024v2: Theorem1.18(1), Corollary1.21(7); compact whole-submanifold setting and scoped Section19 interfaces read.
exact_secondary_interfaces.AB2003: Definition3.3, Theorem1.2/3.11, Proposition3.13; published exact scope checked, older extension/support inputs retained.
exact_secondary_interfaces.Vigny0711.3782v2: Theorem5.1, Lemma2.1 with following Section5 extension; published PDF inaccessible and published locators not certified.

next_unit: Adopt the direct horizontal descent proof at its natural linear-current home and apply it to the elliptic example; continue complete external dependency verification before full Siu adoption.
